ns2:course.label: Industrial Design III
ns2:course.description: Design of user centered products for mass production; experience in the iterative problem solving processes and methods. Addresses practical constraints such as sustainability, environmental factors/ergonomics, manufacturing and materials, social and political and economic. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: ARTD 202.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: ARTD 202.
